raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Associate / Emerging Lead - Fund Accounting	Apr 2022 - May 2026
State Street Corporate Services
Fund Operations & NAV Oversight: Managed end-to-end fund accounting and investment services across 100+ complex Equity, Debt, Hybrid, and ETF funds representing approximately USD 200 million AUM.
Valuation & Quality Control: Directed daily, weekly, and monthly NAV validation workflows, systematically reviewing income/expense accruals, pricing inputs, corporate actions, and cap stock activities prior to market release.
Risk Mitigation & Reconciliations: Conducted rigorous portfolio valuation reviews and data validation; investigated and resolved intricate cash, position, and NAV accounting breaks to eliminate operational exceptions.
Financial Reporting & Audit Coordination: Spearheaded financial reporting support and regulatory compliance deliverables; served as the primary operational liaison for auditors and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure timely, seamless audit completions.
Leadership & Team Mentorship: Promoted to Emerging Lead based on consistent delivery excellence; supervised and reviewed the deliverables of 3 team members, providing targeted guidance to uphold stringent data quality and procedural standards.
Process Innovation: Designed and implemented comprehensive SOPs and workflow enhancements that successfully optimized operational efficiency and minimized risk across fund reporting lines.
Hybrid & Alternative Asset Readiness: Integrated deep knowledge of Private Equity structures (including GP/ LP frameworks, capital calls, distributions, and waterfall methodologies) to support the analysis of hybrid fund structures and cross-train team members.
Senior Analyst	Aug 2020 - Mar 2022
GlobalLogic Technologies
Performed high-accuracy pre-NAV calculations, asset reconciliations, pricing validation, expense accrual reviews, and cap stock monitoring to ensure pristine quality across fund deliverables.
Coordinated closely with reporting lines to deliver structured audit logs and ensure compliance with strict financial close schedules.
SAP FICO Training & Professional Development	Sep 2018 - Aug 2020
Professional Upskilling Gap Fulfillment
Completed comprehensive hands-on training covering General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, and ERP-based financial operations.
Successfully built a robust corporate financial reporting foundation to enhance analytical frameworks and support specialized investment accounting workflows.
Analyst	Sep 2016 - Sep 2018
Wipro Limited
Managed investment transactions processing, operational data validation, corporate client servicing support, and daily analytical report generation.
EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS Certified Investment Banking Operations Professional (CIBOP) - Imarticus Learning 2021 Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Badruka College of Commerce & Arts 2013 - 2016 TECHNICAL SKILLS & ADDITIONAL KNOWLEDGE
Technical Systems:	Advanced Excel (XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, IF Functions), MCH, eHorizon, SAP FICO, Google Sheets, Microsoft Office Suite
raw_sections.awards:
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Fast-Track Promotion: Elevated to Emerging Lead at State Street for demonstrating exceptional leadership capabilities, consistency in delivery, and deep technical ownership.
Performance Recognition: Honored as a Star Performer and awarded Rookie of the Month for rapid onboarding and process accuracy.
Client Excellence: Received formal Client Appreciation certificates for delivering error-free migration packages and managing tight closing reporting windows seamlessly.
